_note: Scopes for jobs/deep-review.json, in posting order (value at risk first). Together they cover all 66 audited files; each job reviews one scope, and `contracts` gets its first four files.

perp-engine.title: Perp engine: positions, funding, liquidation sweep, requote

perp-vault.title: Perp vault and mark: staker shares, exit queue, token-side yield, mark price

hook-swap.title: Hook swap path: fees, surtax, fee routing, pre-trade liquidation sweep

hook-reserves.title: Hook reserves: relaunch reserve, legacy buyback, gacha credit, death detection

registry-lifecycle.title: Registry lifecycle: summon, death, relaunch, emergency, successor

pool-reserve.title: Pool operations: seeding, reserve position, floor, redemption and migration claims

rotation-treasury.title: Treasury rotation: rotation slices, venues, quote oracle, treasury governor (the two mocks are testnet-only: in scope if a mainnet path can reach them)

nft-gacha.title: Collections and gacha: tickets, pity, collection ledger floor, vault, factory

genesis-governance.title: Genesis presale, dividend and brew governance

launch-seed.title: Launch path: progressive seeder, launch sniper guard, migration vesting

art-render.title: Art and rendering: on-chain token art, trait upload, badge art (render/ files are left out of the default build's own sources but import fine from tests)

deploy-config.title: Deployment: what the scripts deploy, wire and hand over, and any state they could ship that is exploitable or stuck
